how_to_apply: Send the application with all supporting documents to the undersigned (Secretary (Science & Technology), Govt. of A.P, Itanagar) by post or by email to [email protected].
Enclose attested copies of educational certificates, marksheets and experience certificates from class 10th onwards.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the top of the application.
Application must be sent on or before 11th December, 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview APSAC, Itanagar reserves the right to cancel / postpone the interview without assigning any reason

content_sections.heading: APSAC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. APSAC-12012/1/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download APSAC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: First class M.Sc Geology with minimum 3 years relevant working/research experience in the field of Remote Sensing & GIS. M.Sc degree with an aggregate minimum of 65% (average of all semesters) or equivalent grade from a recognized university. Experience: Minimum 3 years relevant working/research experience in the field of Remote Sensing & GIS Age limit: Maximum 32 years Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years Other conditions: Consistently good academic records and experience expected Desirable: Experience in carrying out NRSC/SAC/NESAC project Working experience in landslide mapping & monitoring projects Expertise in satellite data processing and handling software such as ArcGIS, QGIS, ERDAS Imagine etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely project base temporary engagement under SILAAS Phase-II Period of service: 1 year

content_sections.heading: How Will APSAC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting Interview (physical mode only) Shortlisted candidates will be informed separately about date and venue of interview Interview held through physical mode only

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of educational certificates from class 10th onwards Attested copies of marksheets Recent passport size photograph affixed on top of the application Original credentials and full bio-data at the interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APSAC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Send the application with all supporting documents to the undersigned (Secretary (Science & Technology), Govt. of A.P, Itanagar) by post or by email to [email protected] . Enclose attested copies of educational certificates, marksheets and experience certificates from class 10th onwards. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the top of the application. Application must be sent on or before 11th December, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview APSAC, Itanagar reserves the right to cancel / postpone the interview without assigning any reason
